> ## Verified project structure
>
> - ARENA describes a two-stage project: a Core Research Stage followed by a Research Commercialisation Stage.
> - The Core Research Stage included cell design/construction and evaluation of Pilbara ores.
> - The later stage was scoped to electrolyser engineering/construction, process-safety analysis, unit manufacturing and commissioning of an optimised plant.
> - The overall project sought a low-temperature (<130°C) alkaline solid-state slurry electrolyser compatible with lower-grade Pilbara ore.
>
> ## Current public evidence boundary
>
> - The linked final report is explicitly described as learnings from the **Core Research Stage**.
> - ARENA lists the project end date as 2026-03-02.
> - At collection on 2026-07-28, the project page linked the Core Research Final Report and research posters, but no separately published Research Commercialisation/Stage 2 final report was visible.
> - Therefore the public record supports completion of the Core Research Stage, but does **not** establish that the 100 kg system, balance of plant, commissioning or TRL 6 target was achieved.
>
> ## Interpretation boundary
>
> - Absence of a public Stage 2 final report is a monitoring signal, not proof of cancellation, delay or technical failure.
> - The 100 kg feed, >=50% conversion and TRL 6 statements remain project targets unless a later operating report is published.
